properties.title: Prince: SiteStructureAddressPoint
properties.description: Every addressed site the Source agency publishes (Records), plus Overture addresses no Record matched (Gap-fill candidates, status = 'gap_fill_candidate').

table:columns.name: uid
table:columns.description: The project's stable ID: the Address UID for an address point, the segment UID for a road

table:columns.name: gers_id
table:columns.description: Overture GERS ID linked to this row (a reference that can change between Overture releases)

table:columns.name: status
table:columns.description: 'record' (the Source agency's own point) or 'gap_fill_candidate' (an Overture address to check)

table:columns.name: source
table:columns.description: Source key: the registry's Source agency layer, or 'overture' for a Gap-fill candidate

table:columns.name: source_id
table:columns.description: The row's own ID in its source

table:columns.name: source_license
table:columns.description: Licence of the row's source: the registry's status for agency data, Overture's per-source licence for a Gap-fill candidate

table:columns.name: link_method
table:columns.description: How the Address UID was found: agency_record, minted, or carried over by the lineage ledger

table:columns.name: match_distance_m
table:columns.description: Distance in metres to the Overture address the Record matched

table:columns.name: street_key_match
table:columns.description: Whether the matched Overture address has the same parsed street

table:columns.name: source_site_type
table:columns.description: The source's own site type (e.g. PUBLIC TELEPHONE), kept as published

table:columns.name: discrpagid
table:columns.description: Agency responsible for the row: the NGUID domain, a .invalid placeholder until the 911 authority opts in

table:columns.name: dateupdate
table:columns.description: When the build last wrote or changed the row (UTC)

table:columns.name: effective
table:columns.description: When the boundary takes effect; empty when the source gives no date

table:columns.name: expire
table:columns.description: When the boundary stops applying; empty when the source gives no date

table:columns.name: nguid
table:columns.description: NENA globally unique ID, built from the row's own UID under discrpagid's domain (never a GERS ID)

table:columns.name: country
table:columns.description: Country code: US or CA

table:columns.name: a1
table:columns.description: State or province code

table:columns.name: a2
table:columns.description: County or census division name

table:columns.name: a3
table:columns.description: Municipality name, or 'Unincorporated' outside every municipality

table:columns.name: add_number
table:columns.description: Address number

table:columns.name: addnum_suf
table:columns.description: Address number suffix (e.g. 'B' in 30B)

table:columns.name: st_predir
table:columns.description: Street name pre-directional, NENA registry word (e.g. North)

table:columns.name: st_pretyp
table:columns.description: Street name pre-type, NENA registry word (e.g. State Route; Rue in Canada)

table:columns.name: st_name
table:columns.description: Street name

table:columns.name: st_postyp
table:columns.description: Street name post-type, NENA registry word (e.g. Street)

table:columns.name: st_posdir
table:columns.description: Street name post-directional, NENA registry word

table:columns.name: post_comm
table:columns.description: Postal community name

table:columns.name: post_code
table:columns.description: Postal code or ZIP code

table:columns.name: unit
table:columns.description: Unit, suite or apartment

table:columns.name: placement
table:columns.description: How the point was placed on the site; 'Unknown' where the source doesn't say

table:columns.name: geom
table:columns.description: Geometry, WGS 84 longitude/latitude

site_structure_address_point.title: SiteStructureAddressPoint GeoParquet
site_structure_address_point.description: Every addressed site the Source agency publishes (Records), plus Overture addresses no Record matched (Gap-fill candidates, status = 'gap_fill_candidate').
